items.title: 如何接入到客户端
items.content:
# Codex / Claude Code 配置说明

本页公开可访问，不需要登录。把 `密钥API_KEY` 换成你的密钥后即可使用。

## Codex

编辑 `~/.codex/config.toml`（Windows 为 `%USERPROFILE%\.codex\config.toml`）：

```toml
disable_response_storage = true
model = "grok-4.7"
model_reasoning_effort = "high"
# 推理摘要：auto / concise / detailed / none；none 表示关闭摘要（当前默认）
model_reasoning_summary = "none"
model_provider = "lvyrix"

[model_providers.lvyrix]
base_url = "https://newapi.lvyrix.com/v1"
name = "lvyrix"
requires_openai_auth = true
wire_api = "responses"
```

再编辑 `~/.codex/auth.json`（Windows 为 `%USERPROFILE%\.codex\auth.json`）：

```json
{
  "OPENAI_API_KEY": "密钥API_KEY"
}
```

然后启动：

```bash
codex
```

`model_reasoning_summary` 支持 `auto`（由 Codex 自动选择）、`concise`（简要摘要）、`detailed`（详细摘要）和 `none`（不发送推理摘要）。

## Claude Code

编辑 `~/.claude/settings.json`（Windows 为 `%USERPROFILE%\.claude\settings.json`）：

```json
{
  "env": {
    "ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN": "密钥API_KEY",
    "ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL": "https://newapi.lvyrix.com",
    "ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL": "grok-4.7",
    "ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL": "grok-4.7",
    "ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL": "grok-4.7",
    "CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC": "1"
  },
  "effortLevel": "high"
}
```

然后启动：

```bash
claude
```

      transform-origin: 70% 40%;

      transform-origin: center;
      animation: flap 0.46s ease-in-out infinite;

    .p2 { animation: puff 0.95s linear 0.32s infinite; }
    .p3 { animation: puff 0.95s linear 0.62s infinite; }
    .crab {
      animation: pace 9s ease-in-out infinite;

      transform-box: fill-box;
      transform-origin: center;
      animation: scuttle 0.28s ease-in-out infinite;

    .foot-far .foot-shape { fill: #e7b07a; }
    .foot-near .foot-shape { fill: #f08a2a; }
    .toes { fill: none; stroke: #243044; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; }

    @keyframes blink {
      0%, 86%, 100% { transform: scaleY(0.04); }
      90%, 94% { transform: scaleY(1); }
    }
    @keyframes wiggle {
      0%, 100% { transform: rotate(10deg); }
      50% { transform: rotate(-12deg); }
    }
    @keyframes flap {
      0%, 100% { transform: scaleY(1); }
      50% { transform: scaleY(0.22); }

    @keyframes fly-a {
      from { transform: translate(-80px, 46px); }
      to { transform: translate(1220px, 18px); }

    @keyframes fly-b {
      from { transform: translate(-120px, 150px); }
      to { transform: translate(1240px, 96px); }
    }
    @keyframes puff {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(0.35); opacity: 0; }
      18% { opacity: 0.45; }
      100% { transform: translate(-42px, -20px) scale(1.35); opacity: 0; }
    }
    @keyframes pace {
      0% { transform: translate(36px, 502px) scaleX(1); }
      46% { transform: translate(168px, 502px) scaleX(1); }
      50% { transform: translate(168px, 502px) scaleX(-1); }
      96% { transform: translate(36px, 502px) scaleX(-1); }
      100% { transform: translate(36px, 502px) scaleX(1); }
    }
    @keyframes scuttle {
      0%, 100% { transform: rotate(0deg); }
      50% { transform: rotate(6deg); }
    }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      .lid, .fish-wiggle, .wingflap, .gull-a, .gull-b, .puff, .crab, .crab-legs {
        animation: none !important;

        <rect x="14" y="-7" width="18" height="14" rx="4" fill="#f6e27a" stroke="#243044" stroke-width="2.4" />
        <circle cx="23" cy="0" r="3" fill="#fff9d6" />
      </g>
      <g id="head-group">
        <circle cx="346" cy="186" r="7.5" fill="#e4533a" stroke="#243044" stroke-width="2.4" />

        <path d="M328 198 C348 168 352 136 396 116 C414 106 418 124 406 138 C386 166 362 190 344 210 C326 206 318 204 328 198 Z" fill="#fffdf8" stroke="#243044" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round" />

        <path d="M386 92 C372 70 360 80 372 98" fill="#fffdf8" stroke="#243044" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round" />
        <path d="M396 88 C386 64 372 74 384 96" fill="#fffdf8" stroke="#243044" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round" />

        <ellipse cx="418" cy="114" rx="36" ry="30" fill="#fffdf8" stroke="#243044" stroke-width="3" />

        <path d="M384 98 C386 70 430 62 454 88 C436 78 406 82 390 104 Z" fill="#1f86a0" stroke="#243044" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round" />
        <path d="M446 86 C482 78 504 94 490 106 C468 96 446 98 438 100 Z" fill="#1f86a0" stroke="#243044" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round" />
        <path d="M392 100 C414 92 442 94 458 104" fill="none" stroke="#f7fbff" stroke-width="3.2" stroke-linecap="round" />

        <ellipse cx="438" cy="116" rx="15" ry="12" fill="#f6b15a" />
        <path d="M418 102 Q432 94 448 102" fill="none" stroke="#243044" stroke-width="2.6" stroke-linecap="round" />
        <circle cx="442" cy="116" r="7.2" fill="#fffdf8" stroke="#243044" stroke-width="2.3" />
        <circle cx="444" cy="117" r="3.5" fill="#243044" />
        <circle cx="445.6" cy="115.2" r="1.35" fill="#ffffff" />
        <ellipse class="lid" cx="442" cy="116" rx="8" ry="7.6" fill="#fffdf8" />
        <ellipse cx="424" cy="128" rx="8" ry="4.2" fill="#f6b5a0" opacity="0.7" />

        <path d="M452 118 C520 128 592 134 640 140 C626 184 556 208 486 190 C446 178 428 150 452 118 Z" fill="url(#pouch)" stroke="#243044" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round" />
        <path d="M470 142 C530 154 590 160 628 150" fill="none" stroke="#e08f2e" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.75" />
        <path d="M478 160 C536 174 582 176 616 164" fill="none" stroke="#e08f2e" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.5" />
        <g class="fish-wiggle">
          <g transform="translate(596 162)">
            <path d="M0 18 C-14 24 -15 48 0 54 C15 48 14 24 0 18 Z" fill="#7fd0de" stroke="#243044" stroke-width="2.6" />
            <path d="M-7 48 L-20 70 L0 56 L20 70 L7 48 Z" fill="#f27d8a" stroke="#243044" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linejoin="round" />
            <path d="M-12 32 C-24 26 -22 40 -12 38 Z" fill="#5eb8c8" stroke="#243044" stroke-width="2" />
            <circle cx="5" cy="32" r="2.1" fill="#243044" />
            <circle cx="6" cy="31" r="0.8" fill="#ffffff" />
          </g>
        </g>

        <path d="M448 102 C512 86 590 98 648 116 C664 120 668 130 652 134 C604 124 530 116 456 120 C444 116 440 108 448 102 Z" fill="url(#beak)" stroke="#243044" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round" />
        <path d="M636 114 C656 118 664 130 646 134 C636 124 634 118 636 114 Z" fill="#fff1b8" stroke="#243044" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round" />
        <ellipse cx="478" cy="106" rx="16" ry="8" fill="#ffe38a" stroke="#243044" stroke-width="2.4" />
        <path d="M470 112 l12 2" stroke="#c86a12" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" />
        <path d="M456 118 C540 126 610 132 650 134" fill="none" stroke="#c86a12" stroke-width="2" />
      </g>

      <path id="near-outline" class="leg leg-outline" />
      <path id="near-skin" class="leg leg-near" />
      <circle id="near-knee" r="8.4" fill="#243044" />
      <circle id="near-knee-core" r="5.5" fill="#f08a2a" />
      <g id="near-pedal">
        <rect x="-15" y="-4.5" width="30" height="9" rx="2" fill="#243044" />
        <rect x="-15" y="-4.5" width="30" height="3.4" rx="1.4" fill="#3c4c60" />
      </g>
      <g id="near-foot" class="foot foot-near">
        <path class="foot-shape" d="M-2 -6 C10 -16 26 -12 34 -3 C28 3 18 8 8 7 C-2 6 -8 2 -6 -2 C-8 -3 -6 -5 -2 -6 Z" />
        <path class="toes" d="M12 -1 L30 -10 M14 2 L34 0 M12 6 L30 9" />
      </g>
    </g>

    <g id="grass" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"></g>

    <g font-family="Noto Serif CJK SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, serif" fill="#1c4e66">
      <text x="52" y="74" font-size="40" font-weight="700">鹈鹕骑行</text>
      <path d="M54 88 h148" stroke="#1c4e66" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.35" />
      <text x="54" y="114" font-size="16" font-family="Noto Sans CJK SC, Noto Sans, sans-serif" fill="#3e738c">海风里，把脚蹼踩上踏板</text>
    </g>
  </svg>

  <script>
    'use strict';

    var BB = { x: 310, y: 442 };
    var REAR = { x: 150, y: 430 };
    var FRONT = { x: 500, y: 430 };
    var CRANK = 40;
    var WHEEL_R = 82;
    var GEAR = 1.6;
    var CRANK_PERIOD = 1.85;
    var THIGH = 100;
    var SHIN = 96;
    var hips = {
      far: { x: 262, y: 292 },
      near: { x: 290, y: 304 }
    };

    var rider = document.getElementById('rider');
    var head = document.getElementById('head-group');
    var wing = document.getElementById('near-wing');
    var scarf = document.getElementById('scarf');
    var spokesRear = document.getElementById('spokes-rear');
    var spokesFront = document.getElementById('spokes-front');

    function wrap(value, size) {
      return ((value % size) + size) % size;
    }

    function addSpokes(group, cx, cy) {
      var ns = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
      for (var i = 0; i < 12; i += 1) {
        var angle = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / 12;
        var line = document.createElementNS(ns, 'line');
        line.setAttribute('x1', (cx + Math.cos(angle) * 14).toFixed(1));
        line.setAttribute('y1', (cy + Math.sin(angle) * 14).toFixed(1));
        line.setAttribute('x2', (cx + Math.cos(angle) * 63).toFixed(1));
        line.setAttribute('y2', (cy + Math.sin(angle) * 63).toFixed(1));
        line.setAttribute('stroke', '#d7dee6');
        line.setAttribute('stroke-width', '2.3');
        line.setAttribute('stroke-linecap', 'round');
        group.appendChild(line);
      }
      var valve = document.createElementNS(ns, 'line');
      valve.setAttribute('x1', cx);
      valve.setAttribute('y1', cy - 60);
      valve.setAttribute('x2', cx);
      valve.setAttribute('y2', cy - 74);
      valve.setAttribute('stroke', '#243044');
      valve.setAttribute('stroke-width', '3');
      valve.setAttribute('stroke-linecap', 'round');
      group.appendChild(valve);
      var dot = document.createElementNS(ns, 'circle');
      dot.setAttribute('cx', cx);
      dot.setAttribute('cy', cy - 52);
      dot.setAttribute('r', '3.4');
      dot.setAttribute('fill', '#f2b544');
      dot.setAttribute('stroke', '#243044');
      dot.setAttribute('stroke-width', '1.4');
      group.appendChild(dot);
    }

    function buildPlanks() {
      var g = document.getElementById('planks');
      var ns = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
      var fills = ['#e2b56a', '#c99248'];
      for (var x = -224; x < 1500; x += 112) {
        for (var p = 0; p < 2; p += 1) {
          var px = x + p * 56;
          var rect = document.createElementNS(ns, 'rect');
          rect.setAttribute('x', px);
          rect.setAttribute('y', 540);
          rect.setAttribute('width', 52);
          rect.setAttribute('height', 76);
          rect.setAttribute('rx', '1');
          rect.setAttribute('fill', fills[p]);
          g.appendChild(rect);
          var shine = document.createElementNS(ns, 'rect');
          shine.setAttribute('x', px);
          shine.setAttribute('y', 540);
          shine.setAttribute('width', 52);
          shine.setAttribute('height', 6);
          shine.setAttribute('fill', '#fff6e4');
          shine.setAttribute('opacity', '0.5');
          g.appendChild(shine);
          for (var n = 0; n < 2; n += 1) {
            var nail = document.createElementNS(ns, 'circle');
            nail.setAttribute('cx', px + (n === 0 ? 12 : 40));
            nail.setAttribute('cy', n === 0 ? 554 : 598);
            nail.setAttribute('r', '2.1');
            nail.setAttribute('fill', '#a97840');
            g.appendChild(nail);
          }
        }
      }
    }

    function buildWaves() {
      var g = document.getElementById('waves');
      var ns = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
      function wave(y, amp, length, from, to, color, width, opacity) {
        var d = 'M ' + from + ' ' + y + ' Q ' + (from + length / 4) + ' ' + (y - amp) + ' ' + (from + length / 2) + ' ' + y;
        for (var x = from + length; x <= to; x += length / 2) d += ' T ' + x + ' ' + y;
        var path = document.createElementNS(ns, 'path');
        path.setAttribute('d', d);
        path.setAttribute('stroke', color);
        path.setAttribute('stroke-width', width);
        path.setAttribute('opacity', opacity);
        g.appendChild(path);
      }
      wave(352, 10, 160, -320, 1700, '#ffffff', 3, 0.55);
      wave(378, 8, 160, -240, 1700, '#e9fbff', 3, 0.4);
      wave(408, 9, 160, -400, 1700, '#ffffff', 2.5, 0.28);
    }

    function buildGrass() {
      var g = document.getElementById('grass');
      var ns = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
      var colors = ['#3f8d45', '#67b15c', '#2f7a3e'];
      var d = '';
      for (var x = -180; x < 1460; x += 28) {
        var h = 28 + ((x / 28) % 3) * 8;
        var lean = ((x / 28) % 2 === 0) ? 10 : -8;
        d += 'M ' + x + ' 640 C ' + (x + lean * 0.2) + ' ' + (640 - h * 0.5) + ' ' + (x + lean) + ' ' + (640 - h) + ' ' + (x + lean * 0.45) + ' ' + (628 - h);
        d += 'M ' + (x + 8) + ' 640 C ' + (x + 14) + ' ' + (640 - h * 0.4) + ' ' + (x + 18) + ' ' + (620 - h * 0.7) + ' ' + (x + 12) + ' ' + (624 - h * 0.85);
      }
      var path = document.createElementNS(ns, 'path');
      path.setAttribute('d', d);
      path.setAttribute('stroke', colors[0]);
      path.setAttribute('stroke-width', '3');
      g.appendChild(path);
    }

    function solveKnee(hip, ankle) {
      var dx = ankle.x - hip.x;
      var dy = ankle.y - hip.y;
      var dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
      var max = THIGH + SHIN - 0.01;
      var min = Math.abs(THIGH - SHIN) + 0.01;
      dist = Math.min(max, Math.max(min, dist));
      var base = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
      var cosBend = (THIGH * THIGH + dist * dist - SHIN * SHIN) / (2 * THIGH * dist);
      var bend = Math.acos(Math.min(1, Math.max(-1, cosBend)));
      var theta = base - bend;
      return {
        x: hip.x + Math.cos(theta) * THIGH,
        y: hip.y + Math.sin(theta) * THIGH
      };
    }

    function placeLeg(prefix, hip, pedal) {
      var ankle = { x: pedal.x, y: pedal.y - 4 };
      var knee = solveKnee(hip, ankle);
      var d = 'M ' + hip.x.toFixed(1) + ' ' + hip.y.toFixed(1) +
        ' L ' + knee.x.toFixed(1) + ' ' + knee.y.toFixed(1) +
        ' L ' + ankle.x.toFixed(1) + ' ' + ankle.y.toFixed(1);
      document.getElementById(prefix + '-outline').setAttribute('d', d);
      document.getElementById(prefix + '-skin').setAttribute('d', d);
      document.getElementById(prefix + '-knee').setAttribute('cx', knee.x.toFixed(1));
      document.getElementById(prefix + '-knee').setAttribute('cy', knee.y.toFixed(1));
      document.getElementById(prefix + '-knee-core').setAttribute('cx', knee.x.toFixed(1));
      document.getElementById(prefix + '-knee-core').setAttribute('cy', knee.y.toFixed(1));
      document.getElementById(prefix + '-foot').setAttribute('transform', 'translate(' + ankle.x.toFixed(1) + ' ' + ankle.y.toFixed(1) + ') scale(1.18)');
      document.getElementById(prefix + '-pedal').setAttribute('transform', 'translate(' + pedal.x.toFixed(1) + ' ' + pedal.y.toFixed(1) + ')');
    }

    function pedalAt(angle) {
      return {
        x: BB.x + Math.cos(angle) * CRANK,
        y: BB.y + Math.sin(angle) * CRANK
      };
    }

    function render(crank, t) {
      var bob = Math.sin(crank * 2) * 2.4;
      rider.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(155 ' + (40 + bob).toFixed(2) + ')');
      var wheelTurns = (crank / (Math.PI * 2)) * GEAR;
      var deg = wheelTurns * 360;
      spokesRear.setAttribute('transform', 'rotate(' + deg.toFixed(2) + ' ' + REAR.x + ' ' + REAR.y + ')');
      spokesFront.setAttribute('transform', 'rotate(' + deg.toFixed(2) + ' ' + FRONT.x + ' ' + FRONT.y + ')');

      var near = pedalAt(crank);
      var far = pedalAt(crank + Math.PI);
      document.getElementById('crank').setAttribute('x1', far.x.toFixed(1));
      document.getElementById('crank').setAttribute('y1', far.y.toFixed(1));
      document.getElementById('crank').setAttribute('x2', near.x.toFixed(1));
      document.getElementById('crank').setAttribute('y2', near.y.toFixed(1));
      placeLeg('far', hips.far, far);
      placeLeg('near', hips.near, near);

      head.setAttribute('transform', 'rotate(' + (Math.sin(crank) * 1.7).toFixed(2) + ' 348 196)');
      wing.setAttribute('transform', 'rotate(' + (Math.sin(crank + 0.5) * 1.2).toFixed(2) + ' 324 206)');
      scarf.setAttribute('transform', 'rotate(' + (Math.sin(t * 5.4) * 4 + Math.sin(t * 2.2) * 2).toFixed(2) + ' 330 180)');

      var dist = wheelTurns * Math.PI * 2 * WHEEL_R;
      document.getElementById('planks').setAttribute('transform', 'translate(' + (-wrap(dist, 112)).toFixed(2) + ' 0)');
      document.getElementById('grass').setAttribute('transform', 'translate(' + (-wrap(dist * 1.05, 168)).toFixed(2) + ' 0)');
      document.getElementById('waves').setAttribute('transform', 'translate(' + (-wrap(dist * 0.28, 160)).toFixed(2) + ' 0)');
      document.getElementById('clouds-back').setAttribute('transform', 'translate(' + (-wrap(dist * 0.1, 1100)).toFixed(2) + ' 0)');
      document.getElementById('clouds-front').setAttribute('transform', 'translate(' + (-wrap(dist * 0.2, 1100)).toFixed(2) + ' 0)');
      document.getElementById('boats').setAttribute('transform', 'translate(' + (-wrap(dist * 0.16, 1400)).toFixed(2) + ' 0)');
    }

    addSpokes(spokesRear, REAR.x, REAR.y);
    addSpokes(spokesFront, FRONT.x, FRONT.y);
    buildPlanks();
    buildWaves();
    buildGrass();

    var params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
    var reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
    if (params.has('freeze')) {
      render(Number(params.get('freeze')) * Math.PI * 2, 0.4);
    } else if (reduce) {
      render(0.35 * Math.PI * 2, 0.4);
    } else {
      function loop(now) {
        var t = now / 1000;
        render((t / CRANK_PERIOD) * Math.PI * 2, t);
        requestAnimationFrame(loop);
      }
      requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    }
  </script>
